free.q: Although he was exhausted, Tunde insisted on finishing the assignment. What does this sentence suggest about Tunde?
free.e: Continuing despite tiredness shows strong determination.

free.q: Nigeria gained independence from British colonial rule in which year?
free.e: Nigeria became an independent nation on 1 October 1960.

free.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to 'abundant'.
free.e: Abundant means plentiful, so its opposite is scarce.

free.q: She could barely conceal her disappointment when the result was announced. This implies that she:
free.e: 'Conceal' means to hide, so she was trying to hide her disappointment.
